# Crabka Documentation Site Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Publish a Zola-built documentation site to GitHub Pages with auto-generated Operator (CRD) and Broker (server config, topic configs, protocol API table) references plus rustdoc, generated from source at CI build time.

**Architecture:** A new `crabka-docgen` workspace crate depends on `crabka-operator` and `crabka-broker`, pulls their in-process source-of-truth data structures, and renders Zola markdown via a single JSON-Schema→markdown walker (shared by CRD and broker-config rendering). A Zola site under `website/` holds hand-written narrative pages plus the generated reference tree (git-ignored). A GitHub Actions workflow generates content, runs `cargo doc`, builds Zola, and deploys via `actions/deploy-pages` on push to `main`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust (clap, serde_json, schemars 1.2, anyhow), Zola (AdiDoks theme), GitHub Actions (`actions/deploy-pages`).

---

## Execution Batches

Per the project's parallel-batch convention. Tasks within a batch touch disjoint file sets and may be dispatched concurrently. Wait for a batch to complete and pass review before starting the next.

- **Batch 1 (parallel):** Task 1 (broker source exposures — `crates/broker/**`) ‖ Task 6 (Zola site scaffold — `website/**`). Disjoint files.
- **Batch 2 (sequential):** Tasks 2→3→4→5 (the `crabka-docgen` crate). Same crate, shared `lib.rs`/`main.rs` — sequential. Depends on Batch 1's broker exposures compiling.
- **Batch 3 (parallel):** Task 7 (CI workflow — `.github/workflows/docs.yml`) ‖ Task 8 (`.gitignore` + `website/README.md`). Depends on Batches 1–2.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the renderer**

Add above the test module in `crates/docgen/src/schema_md.rs`:

```rust
/// Render the `properties` of an object schema as a markdown table with one
/// row per (possibly nested) field. Columns: Field, Type, Required, Default,
/// Description. Nested object properties recurse with a dotted path.
pub fn render_field_table(schema: &Value) -> String {
    let mut rows = String::new();
    collect_rows(schema, "", &mut rows);
    let mut out = String::from(
        "| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |\n\
         |-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|\n",
    );
    out.push_str(&rows);
    out
}

fn collect_rows(schema: &Value, prefix: &str, out: &mut String) {
    let required: Vec<&str> = schema
        .get("required")
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let Some(props) = schema.get("properties").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
        return;
    };
    for (name, field) in props {
        let path = if prefix.is_empty() { name.clone() } else { format!("{prefix}.{name}") };
        let ty = type_label(field);
        let req = if required.contains(&name.as_str()) { "yes" } else { "no" };
        let default = field
            .get("default")
            .map(render_default)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let desc = field
            .get("description")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .unwrap_or("")
            .replace('\n', " ");
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "| `{path}` | {ty} | {req} | {default} | {desc} |\n"
        ));
        // Recurse into nested objects.
        if field.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("object")
            && field.get("properties").is_some()
        {
            collect_rows(field, &path, out);
        }
    }
}

fn type_label(field: &Value) -> String {
    match field.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
        Some("array") => {
            let item = field
                .get("items")
                .map(type_label)
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "any".into());
            format!("array<{item}>")
        }
        Some(t) => t.to_string(),
        None => "object".to_string(),
    }
}

fn render_default(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v {
        Value::String(s) => format!("`{s}`"),
        other => format!("`{other}`"),
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the generator**

Add to `crates/docgen/src/operator.rs`. Uses the same `K::crd()` entry point as the operator's `gen_crds`:

```rust
use kube::CustomResourceExt;
use crabka_operator::crd::{Kafka, KafkaNodePool, KafkaRebalance, KafkaTopic, KafkaUser};

/// Build a reference page for every CRD the operator owns.
pub fn crd_pages() -> Vec<CrdPage> {
    vec![
        page::<Kafka>(),
        page::<KafkaNodePool>(),
        page::<KafkaTopic>(),
        page::<KafkaUser>(),
        page::<KafkaRebalance>(),
    ]
}

fn page<K: CustomResourceExt>() -> CrdPage {
    let crd = K::crd();
    let kind = crd.spec.names.kind.clone();
    let group = crd.spec.group.clone();
    // Use the storage version's schema (the one served/stored).
    let version = crd
        .spec
        .versions
        .iter()
        .find(|v| v.storage)
        .or_else(|| crd.spec.versions.first())
        .expect("CRD has at least one version");
    let schema_json: Value = version
        .schema
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|s| s.open_api_v3_schema.as_ref())
        .map(|s| serde_json::to_value(s).expect("schema to json"))
        .unwrap_or(Value::Null);

    let spec = schema_json.pointer("/properties/spec").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
    let status = schema_json.pointer("/properties/status").cloned();

    let mut body = format!(
        "**API group/version:** `{group}/{}`\n\n## Spec\n\n",
        version.name
    );
    body.push_str(&render_field_table(&spec));
    if let Some(status) = status {
        if status.get("properties").is_some() {
            body.push_str("\n## Status\n\n");
            body.push_str(&render_field_table(&status));
        }
    }

    CrdPage { slug: kind.to_lowercase(), title: kind, body }
}
```

```rust
/// Server-config reference, rendered from the `FileConfig` JSON schema.
pub fn server_config_md() -> String {
    let schema = schemars::schema_for!(crabka_broker::file_config::FileConfig);
    let value = serde_json::to_value(&schema).expect("FileConfig schema serializes");
    let mut out = String::from(
        "Crabka brokers are configured from a TOML file. The fields below are \
         the top-level keys and nested tables of that file.\n\n",
    );
    out.push_str(&render_field_table(&value));
    out
}

/// Topic-config reference (the `AlterConfigs` whitelist).
pub fn topic_configs_md() -> String {
    let mut out = String::from(
        "These dynamic per-topic configs are accepted by `AlterConfigs` / \
         `IncrementalAlterConfigs`. Unknown keys are rejected with \
         `INVALID_CONFIG`.\n\n\
         | Key | Type | Default | KIP | Description |\n\
         |-----|------|---------|-----|-------------|\n",
    );
    for d in crabka_broker::topic_config_docs() {
        let default = d.default.map(|x| format!("`{x}`")).unwrap_or_default();
        let kip = d.kip.unwrap_or("—");
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "| `{}` | {} | {} | {} | {} |\n",
            d.key, d.value_type, default, kip, d.description
        ));
    }
    out
}

/// Protocol API catalog: every Kafka API key the broker advertises.
pub fn protocol_apis_md() -> String {
    use crabka_protocol::api_key::ApiKey;
    let mut out = String::from(
        "The Kafka protocol APIs this broker advertises in its \
         `ApiVersions` (key 18) response, with the supported version range \
         for each.\n\n\
         | API Key | Name | Min Version | Max Version |\n\
         |---------|------|-------------|-------------|\n",
    );
    let mut apis = crabka_broker::api_catalog::supported_apis();
    apis.sort_by_key(|a| a.api_key);
    for a in apis {
        let name: &'static str = ApiKey::from_i16(a.api_key)
            .map(<&'static str>::from)
            .unwrap_or("?");
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "| {} | {} | {} | {} |\n",
            a.api_key, name, a.min_version, a.max_version
        ));
    }
    out
}
```

Note: confirm the `ApiKey` import path (`crabka_protocol::api_key::ApiKey`) and that `ApiKey: IntoStaticStr` (it derives `strum::IntoStaticStr`, so `<&'static str>::from(key)` yields the variant name). Confirm `from_i16` exists (it does — used in `api_key.rs` tests).

## Task 5: docgen CLI — write the Zola reference tree

Assemble pages with Zola front matter and write them under an output dir.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test for front-matter wrapping**

`crates/docgen/src/emit.rs`:

```rust
//! Wrap generated markdown bodies in Zola front matter and write the
//! reference tree to disk.

use std::path::Path;

/// Wrap a body in Zola TOML front matter.
pub fn with_front_matter(title: &str, weight: u32, body: &str) -> String {
    format!("+++\ntitle = \"{title}\"\nweight = {weight}\n+++\n\n{body}")
}

/// Write the full `reference/` tree (operator + broker pages and section
/// indexes) under `out_dir`. Overwrites existing files.
pub fn write_reference_tree(out_dir: &Path) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    use crate::{broker, operator};
    use std::fs;

    let op_dir = out_dir.join("operator");
    let br_dir = out_dir.join("broker");
    fs::create_dir_all(&op_dir)?;
    fs::create_dir_all(&br_dir)?;

    // Section indexes.
    fs::write(out_dir.join("_index.md"),
        with_front_matter("Reference", 30,
            "Auto-generated API references for the Crabka operator and broker."))?;
    fs::write(op_dir.join("_index.md"),
        with_front_matter("Operator (CRDs)", 10,
            "Custom Resource Definitions owned by the Crabka operator."))?;
    fs::write(br_dir.join("_index.md"),
        with_front_matter("Broker", 20,
            "Broker server config, topic configs, and the Kafka protocol API surface."))?;

    // Operator CRD pages.
    for (i, page) in operator::crd_pages().into_iter().enumerate() {
        let weight = (i as u32 + 1) * 10;
        fs::write(op_dir.join(format!("{}.md", page.slug)),
            with_front_matter(&page.title, weight, &page.body))?;
    }

    // Broker pages.
    fs::write(br_dir.join("server-config.md"),
        with_front_matter("Server Configuration", 10, &broker::server_config_md()))?;
    fs::write(br_dir.join("topic-configs.md"),
        with_front_matter("Topic Configs", 20, &broker::topic_configs_md()))?;
    fs::write(br_dir.join("protocol-apis.md"),
        with_front_matter("Protocol APIs", 30, &broker::protocol_apis_md()))?;

    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tempfile::tempdir;

    #[test]
    fn front_matter_wraps_body() {
        let s = with_front_matter("Kafka", 10, "hello");
        assert!(s.starts_with("+++\ntitle = \"Kafka\"\nweight = 10\n+++\n"));
        assert!(s.contains("hello"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn writes_full_tree() {
        let dir = tempdir().unwrap();
        write_reference_tree(dir.path()).unwrap();
        assert!(dir.path().join("operator/kafka.md").exists());
        assert!(dir.path().join("broker/protocol-apis.md").exists());
        assert!(dir.path().join("broker/server-config.md").exists());
        let kafka = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("operator/kafka.md")).unwrap();
        assert!(kafka.contains("title = \"Kafka\""));
    }
}
```

Add `tempfile = { workspace = true }` under `[dev-dependencies]` in `crates/docgen/Cargo.toml`.

Replace `crates/docgen/src/main.rs`:

```rust
use std::path::PathBuf;

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "crabka-docgen", about = "Generate Crabka reference docs")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Command,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Command {
    /// Write the full reference tree (operator + broker) under --out.
    All {
        /// Output directory, e.g. website/content/reference.
        #[arg(long)]
        out: PathBuf,
    },
}

fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();
    match cli.command {
        Command::All { out } => {
            crabka_docgen::emit::write_reference_tree(&out)?;
            eprintln!("wrote reference tree to {}", out.display());
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}
```

```md
Crabka is a Rust reimplementation of Apache Kafka. It speaks the Apache
```

## Task 7: GitHub Actions deploy workflow

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/docs.yml`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the workflow**

`.github/workflows/docs.yml`:

```yaml
name: docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "website/**"
      - "crates/docgen/**"
      - "crates/operator/**"
      - "crates/broker/**"
      - "crates/protocol/**"
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "website/**"
      - "crates/docgen/**"
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: docs-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Generate reference markdown
        run: cargo run -p crabka-docgen -- all --out website/content/reference
      - name: Build rustdoc
        run: cargo doc --no-deps --workspace
      - name: Stage rustdoc into site
        run: |
          mkdir -p website/static/api/rust
          cp -r target/doc/* website/static/api/rust/
      - name: Stage branding images
        run: |
          mkdir -p website/static/images
          cp docs/*.png website/static/images/ || true
      - name: Install Zola
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: zola@0.19.2
      - name: Build site
        run: zola build
        working-directory: website
      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: website/public

  deploy:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```

Note: confirm the pinned Zola version against the latest stable release at implementation time; pin to a concrete version (not `latest`) for reproducibility. The toolchain action `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` is fine, or switch to one honoring `rust-toolchain.toml` if the workspace needs the pinned nightly/MSRV — check whether `cargo doc --workspace` succeeds on stable; if the workspace requires the pinned toolchain (edition 2024 / rust 1.95), use `actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1` which reads `rust-toolchain.toml`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Lint the workflow locally (optional but recommended)**

Run: `actionlint .github/workflows/docs.yml` if `actionlint` is installed. Expected: no errors. (Skip if not installed.)

- [ ] **Step 3: Document the one-time Pages setting**

This cannot be automated. In the commit message and PR description, note: *Repo Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source = "GitHub Actions"* must be set once by a maintainer before the first deploy succeeds.

- [ ] **Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add .github/workflows/docs.yml
git commit -m "ci: build and deploy docs site to GitHub Pages"
```
